audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose never names the actual lane clock. Charm (E) is a flat 12s at every rank and 975 range; Hwei's step-up decision is entirely that timer.
audit.why: Kit file: Ahri E cd "12", range 975, hardCC. Hwei has no dash and R range 1300.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty is decided by Charm's flat 12s: behind minions while it is up, walk up on zero. 51.15% over 5,263 games matches a lane that is even until level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text used a fabricated Hwei ability ("Severed Passion E") and the level chart put Level 6 on Ahri while the content layer said Skill.
audit.why: Hwei's E casts are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw (kit text). Spirit Rush is 140/120/100, so the first-item window — not level 6 — is where Ahri's ult is reliably up.
audit.corrected: Level 1-3 Hwei, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 skill, first item Ahri (Spirit Rush back every 120s), 2+ items Hwei.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Charm instantly stops movement abilities, Orb of Deception returns as TRUE damage, and Essence Theft heals Ahri through chip poke. Hwei's own E casts were mislabelled ("EE fear", "EQ root") — the fear is Grim Visage (EQ) and the root is Gaze of the Abyss (EW).
audit.why: Ahri kit: Q trueDamage flag plus Riot text 'true damage on the way back'; E text 'instantly stopping movement abilities'; P heal flag. Hwei E text lists Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw in Q/W/E order.
audit.corrected: Stack HP rather than MR — her Q return ignores resistances. Buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades because Essence Theft heals her chip back. Grim Visage (EQ) is the fear, Gaze of the Abyss (EW) the root.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Charm 12s flat, Orb 7s flat, Hwei R 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Charm 12s is the only real window; Orb's 7s means poke never stops.

audit.whatIsWrong: 25 MISGENDER hits — Ahri referred to as he/his/him throughout.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.
